data.long_meaning: In Greek, Leelah means 'God's harmony'. This name embodies the beauty and balance of the divine will, reflecting the harmony and order that pervade the universe. The name Leelah carries the meaning “God's harmony” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Leelah usually hope their child will grow to embody god's harmony and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name infused with divine grace and harmony.
data.etymology: Leelah belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's harmony.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Leelah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: Leelah is an uncommon name in Christian communities, but for those who choose it, it carries a deep significance rooted in Greek mythology and the meaning of 'God's harmony'. The name's rarity adds a unique and intriguing element to the bearer's identity and can create a sense of connection to the rich history and culture from which it originates. Furthermore, the name can serve as a daily reminder of the balance and harmony inherent in the world around us and the divine influence that governs it.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Leelah is multifaceted, drawing on both the Greek mythological meaning and the deeper Christian symbolism. On one hand, the name Leelah highlights the harmonious and orderly nature of the universe, reflecting the underlying unity that exists between all things. On the other hand, the name implies the presence and guiding hand of God in this harmony, emphasizing the divine aspect of the world and our place within it.
